```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readxl)      # read .xlsx
library(dplyr)       # data wrangling
library(stringr)     # string ops
library(janitor)     # clean names, tabyl
library(lubridate)   # dates/years handling
library(rsample)     # initial_split / rsample API
library(skimr)       # quick data summaries
library(knitr)
library(here)

set.seed(42) # for reproducibility
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

## Import data 

```{r import}
raw <- read_xlsx("dataset/CSM.xlsx") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() # snake_case column names

dim(raw)
head(raw, 3)
skimr::skim(raw)
```

## Data visualization

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(naniar)   # For missing value plots

# Simple missing values summary
colSums(is.na(raw))

# Percentage missing
colMeans(is.na(raw)) * 100

# Heatmap style visualization
 # bar chart of missing % per variable

```
```{r}
gg_miss_var(raw) 
```
```{r}
vis_miss(raw) 
```


## Missing value imputation

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# median imputation for numeric variables
raw <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    budget = ifelse(is.na(budget), mean(budget, na.rm = TRUE), budget),
    screens = ifelse(is.na(screens), mean(screens, na.rm = TRUE), screens),
    `aggregate_followers` = ifelse(is.na(`aggregate_followers`),
                                   mean(`aggregate_followers`, na.rm = TRUE),
                                   `aggregate_followers`)
  )
```

```{r}
# check for outliers
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(raw, aes(x = "", y = gross)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Gross Revenue Outliers")
```


```{r}
plot(raw$budget, raw$gross)  
```


## Train/Validation split

```{r}
set.seed(123)
library(caret)

trainIndex <- createDataPartition(raw$gross, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- raw[trainIndex, ]
test_data <- raw[-trainIndex, ]
```

```{r}
nrow(train_data) / nrow(raw)  
nrow(test_data) / nrow(raw)   
```


## Model selection

```{r}
full_model <- lm(gross ~ . - movie, data=train_data)
summary(full_model)
```
```{r}
vif(full_model)
```

```{r}
step_model <- step(full_model, direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
summary(step_model)
vif(step_model)
```

`
```{r}
df_clean <- train_data[train_data$gross < quantile(train_data$gross, 0.99), ]  

```

```{r}
full_model <- lm(gross ~ . - movie, data=df_clean)
summary(full_model)
```
```{r}
step_model <- step(full_model, direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
summary(step_model)
vif(step_model)
``` 
```{r}
poly_rating <- lm(gross ~ poly(ratings,2) + budget + screens + sequel + sentiment + views + likes + dislikes + aggregate_followers, data=df_clean)
summary(poly_rating)
```


```{r}
poly_rating_budget <- lm(gross ~ poly(ratings,2) + poly(budget,2) + screens + sequel + sentiment + views + likes + dislikes + aggregate_followers, data=df_clean)
summary(poly_rating_budget)
```
```{r}
poly_rating_budget_scr <- lm(gross ~ poly(ratings,2) + poly(budget,2) + poly(screens,2) + sequel + sentiment + views + likes + dislikes + aggregate_followers, data=df_clean)
summary(poly_rating_budget_scr)
vif(poly_rating_budget_scr)
```
```{r}
step_model_poly <- step(poly_rating_budget_scr, direction = "both", trace = FALSE)
summary(step_model_poly)
vif(step_model_poly)
```



```{r}
log_m <- lm(log(gross) ~ ratings + log(budget) + screens + sequel + sentiment + log(views) + likes + dislikes + aggregate_followers, data=df_clean)
summary(log_m)
vif(log_m)
```
